第二天吴姜就得知了爸妈的体检情况，吴时安和他打电话的时候，高兴的哈哈大笑，身体上的一些小毛病没有了，就连三高都恢复正常了。

吴时安高兴的地方在于，王雅琴再也不能拿他血压说事，管着他喝酒了。

接下来几天，一直到过了元宵节，吴姜的生活都很平淡，送李月芽去学校后，又变得无所事事起来。

期间，地府只给吴姜派发了一次怨灵抓捕任务，还没用自己动手，念念上去就直接搞定了。

他都想好了，再让念念多锻炼几次，以后再碰到这种级别的怨灵任务，他就不出马了，让念念带着勾魂索去抓回来，自己坐享其成，岂不美滋滋。

反正现在他和念念之间缔结了魂契同心咒，就算隔着远距离，两人也能随时传音，还能精准感知到念念的位置，真要是碰到她搞不定的硬茬，自己再过去也不迟。

学生开学之后的第二天，吴姜就接到了老爷子的电话。

“爷爷，有什么事？”

电话那头的老爷子说道：“今天有时间没有，过来接我一趟，我去绿城住一段时间。”

吴姜愣了一下，以为自己没听清，追问道：“爷爷，您说啥？是要来绿城住吗？”

老爷子不耐烦的说道：“你小子年纪轻轻的耳朵就背了？没错，今天过来接我！”

直到挂了电话，吴姜还觉得不可思议，老爷子这是怎么想通的，以前叫了那么多回，都不来，这次自己想通了？

吴姜给老妈打了个电话，就出发回老家了。

到了家之后，吴姜一进门就看到了爷爷已经打包好了两大包东西，看这情况，爷爷这是准备在绿城长住一段时间了？

吴姜心里的好奇心更重了，凑到正弯腰往箱子里装书的老爷子身边。

The next day, Wu Jiang learned about his parents' physical examination. When Wu Shi'an called him, he laughed happily. Some minor physical problems were gone, and even the three highs were back to normal.

What makes Wu Shi'an happy is that Wang Yaqin can no longer control his drinking because of his blood pressure.

In the next few days, until the Lantern Festival, Wu Jiang's life was very dull. After sending Li Yueya to school, he became idle again.

During this period, the underworld only sent Wu Jiang one mission to capture the resentful spirit. Before he even had to do it himself, Nian Nian got it done right away.

He had already thought about it, and asked Niannian to train a few more times. If he encountered a mission of this level of resentful spirits in the future, he would not take part in it. He would let Niannian capture it with the soul hook and enjoy the results by himself.

Anyway, now that he and Nian Nian have formed a soul contract, they can communicate with each other at any time even though they are far apart, and can accurately sense Nian Nian's position. If she really encounters a problem that she can't handle, it's not too late to go there himself.

The day after the students started school, Wu Jiang received a call from the old man.

"Grandpa, what's the matter?"

The old man on the other end of the phone said: "If you have time today, come and pick me up. I'll go to Greentown to stay for a while."

Wu Jiang was stunned for a moment, thinking he didn't hear clearly, and asked: "Grandpa, what did you say? Are you coming to live in Green City?"

The old man said impatiently: "You have lost your ears at such a young age? That's right, come and pick me up today!"

Until he hung up the phone, Wu Jiang still felt incredible. How did the old man figure it out? He had called him so many times before but still didn't come. Now he figured it out this time?

Wu Jiang called his mother and set off back to his hometown.

After arriving home, Wu Jiang saw that his grandfather had already packed two large bags of things as soon as he entered the door. Looking at the situation, grandpa was planning to stay in Greentown for a long time?

Wu Jiang's curiosity became more intense, and she moved closer to the old man who was bending over to load books into a box.
